title: Landing page

fields.label: Headline
fields.name: hero_heading
fields.instructions: Wrap the words that should take the accent colour in <span>…</span>, and use <br> to break the line.

sub_fields.label: The number
sub_fields.name: count
sub_fields.instructions: Written as it should read, e.g. "1,204". The count-up animation is worked out from it.

sub_fields.label: Description for screen readers
sub_fields.name: alt
sub_fields.instructions: The card is one picture as far as assistive technology is concerned, so this sentence is what it reads out.

fields.label: The problem, in one paragraph
fields.name: problem_text
fields.instructions: One paragraph, shown in the red strip under the hero. Emphasis with <strong> is allowed.

sub_fields.label: The figure
sub_fields.name: figure
sub_fields.instructions: Markup is allowed here — this is where the count-up animation lives.

sub_fields.label: Badge
sub_fields.name: tag
sub_fields.instructions: The small label beside the name, e.g. "Most shops". Leave empty for none.

sub_fields.label: What it includes
sub_fields.name: features
sub_fields.instructions: One per line. Begin a line with a minus to show it greyed out as something this plan does not have.

sub_fields.label: Seat prices
sub_fields.name: seats
sub_fields.instructions: One per line, as "5 sites | $199". Leave empty for no table.

sub_fields.label: Button link
sub_fields.name: url
sub_fields.instructions: The checkout link for this plan. Leave empty on the free tier to use the download link.

fields.label: The questions themselves
fields.message: The questions and answers live under FAQ in the sidebar, one entry each, dragged into the order they should be read in. Until the first one is added, the page shows the questions it shipped with.

fields.label: The rows themselves
fields.message: The rows live under Compatibility in the sidebar — the title is the thing, the editor is what is said about it.

description: Every field is optional. Leave one empty and the page shows the copy it was designed with.
